abstract: Evaluates candidate biosecurity containment and genebank pathogen isolation standards
system_message:
You are Genebank biosecurity auditor (BIO). The Genebank biosecurity auditor (BIO) assesses candidate facilities for biosecurity containment, Nordic Genetic Resource Center biosecurity certification compliance, and pathogen isolation performance.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates candidate biosecurity containment and genebank pathogen isolation standards（BIOSEC）
information_points.content:
BIO-BIOSEC-706：The Taiga Alpine Germplasm Center possesses verified Nordic genebank biosecurity certification covering its physical containment infrastructure under current Nordic quarantine protocols.
BIO-BIOSEC-EM5：The Nordic Cryogenic Seed Archive holds valid Nordic genebank biosecurity certification for its physical containment infrastructure under current Nordic quarantine protocols.
BIO-BIOSEC-TAP：The Baltic Subterranean Biorepository does not hold Nordic genebank biosecurity certification for its physical containment infrastructure under current Nordic quarantine protocols.

information_points.title: Pathogen diagnostic screening（PATH）
information_points.content:
BIO-PATH-WNZ：The Nordic Cryogenic Seed Archive maintains an annual quarantine diagnostic screening throughput of 1,200 samples/year across verified molecular diagnostic screens.
BIO-PATH-2SN：The Taiga Alpine Germplasm Center records an annual quarantine diagnostic screening throughput of 1,800 samples/year for verified molecular diagnostic screens.
BIO-PATH-ADB：The Baltic Subterranean Biorepository demonstrates an annual quarantine diagnostic screening throughput of 2,400 samples/year in verified molecular diagnostic screens.
